interface.shortDescription: Grow how you work with AI
interface.longDescription:
See how you work with AI, share a page you control, and learn the practices you're missing. Your own AI reads your sessions; UserRank gets only names and counts.

UserRank keeps an open catalogue of AI practices, from standing instructions and reusable prompts to checking AI work and running agents in parallel. Each practice has a plain-words description, how many people use it, and a short starter prompt to try it.

In ChatGPT and Codex you can:
- Learn a practice you are missing with a starter prompt you send yourself. A practice counts once it shows up in your real work.
- See your UserRank score, level and ranks once you have scored, and how you rank in your tribes.
- Preview a share card and publish it only when you say so; unpublishing deletes the public card and its images.
- Choose who sees each result: only you, anyone with its link, or your page. Hide a practice or tool from others; your score stays.
- Create invite links for friends. Invites are sent only after you press Send.

Your full score is measured from Codex on your computer, where the UserRank plugin's scan skill reads your recent sessions locally and sends only ids and counts (your practices, the skills, MCP servers and plugins your AI used, and how many prompts you typed each day), saved to your account, where you choose what others see. This plugin never reads your chat history or saved details about you, and it never scores you from past conversations.

UserRank keeps product analytics in PostHog's EU cloud: which UserRank tools and pages are used, never your sessions or anything you write. Turn it off in Settings or say "Turn off UserRank analytics". Delete everything any time: say "Delete my UserRank".
